attacks.name: Vibranium Spear
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

If the defender is within |!range| 2 of this character, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice; if it is not, after the attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push the defender Toward this character |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: The Panther‘s Fury
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_medium|.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_medium|.

superPowers.name: Strength of the Ancestors (Affiliation: Wakanda)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, when an allied character Pushes an enemy character, if that character contacts a terrain feature during the Push, it suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Bound
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. During the next |*Vibranium Spear| attack this character makes this Activation, it may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Royal Rebuke
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if the attacking character is within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. This character rolls 4 dice. For each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result, the attacking character suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Defender of Wakanda
superPowers.body: The first time each Turn that another allied character is dealt |!damage| by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
